description: This file defines the DetailView class, which extends ListView to handle displaying detailed information for a single record within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for processing SugarBean objects, managing navigation within record details, and rendering pagination controls.

classes.name: DetailView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering the detail view of a single SugarCRM/SuiteCRM record, including navigation and pagination controls.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DetailView object and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Processes a SugarBean object to retrieve and prepare a specific record based on request parameters, managing navigation context.

methods.name: populateQueryWhere
methods.description: Sets the query's WHERE clause based on whether it's the first view or subsequent navigations.

methods.name: processListNavigation
methods.description: Generates HTML for pagination controls and navigation, including handling of enable/disable states and links.

methods.name: set_base_URL
methods.description: Constructs the base URL used for pagination links by capturing current GET and POST parameters.

methods.name: setListViewRowCount
methods.description: Stores the number of rows in the list view.

methods.name: getListViewRowCount
methods.description: Retrieves the stored count of list view rows.

methods.name: isRequestFromListView
methods.description: Determines if the current request originated from the list view based on session variables and parameters.

methods.name: getVariableFromSession
methods.description: Fetches a session variable used for maintaining state across requests.
